correctness.rationale: Independent local valuations at all four branch points give the ten one-dimensional eigenspaces and genus ten. Character preservation follows from 7 ≡ 1 mod 3. Two exact coefficient-expansion methods coincide for every eigenline. The ten coefficients prove rank 10 or 8 only, by simple pairwise-disjoint quadratic roots; symbolic identity gives j=4 and multiplicity two. The standalone saved verifier reproduces all central computations; finite field checks are not treated as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The exact nonordinary locus and doubled Cartier determinant on the natural one-dimensional moduli of genus-ten maximal (Z/3)^3 covers are motivated Jacobian invariants, not arbitrary data slices. The result distinguishes ordinary and rank-eight configurations, proves rank nine never occurs, provides the unique moduli equality case and its nonreduced multiplicity. The general decomposition and generic operator algorithm do not furnish this geometric stratification without calculating the entire Hasse section.
